text: My daily routine is quite simple, but I follow it every day. I usually wake up at seven o'clock and start my morning with a glass of water and a healthy breakfast. After that, I go to work at nine and stay busy until five in the afternoon. When I finish work, I like to exercise for about an hour, either running or going to the gym. In the evening, I have dinner, watch some TV, or read a book. I try to go to bed before eleven. Being consistent helps me stay healthy and feel good.
